Method of Attack: Distributed via spam emails with malformed attachments
Attachments are 7zip archives containing VBS downloader scripts
VBS downloader downloads and executes Locky ransomware executable
Removes Shadow Volume Copies to prevent recovery
Displays ransom note demanding payment in Bitcoin
Attack Vector: Spam email with subject 'Document invoice_95649_sign_and_return.pdf is complete' spoofed from documents@rightsignature.com
Execution of VBS script leading to Locky ransomware infection
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files with .asasin extension and names like E87091F1-D24A-922B-00F6B112-72BB7EA6EADF.asasin
Ransom notes named asasin.htm and asasin.bmp
Spam email subject line 'Document invoice_95649_sign_and_return.pdf is complete'
